statements.description: Personal data of EU persons must be stored in the EU or EEA.

keys.question: Where is personal data stored in production?
keys.explanation: Choose the region of the primary production datastore that holds personal data. Use EU for EU member states including Finland; EEA for Norway/Iceland/Liechtenstein; US for United States regions; APAC for Asia-Pacific; other for anywhere else.

statements.description: Production datastores holding personal data must use AES-256 at rest.

keys.question: What encryption is used for production data at rest?
keys.explanation: AES-256 if the database/object store uses AES-256 or an approved equivalent. TLS-only if data is encrypted in transit but not at rest. none if production storage is unencrypted. other for any non-listed algorithm.

statements.description: A DPA must be signed when PII is processed; otherwise not_applicable.

keys.question: Is a data processing agreement signed with every processor?
keys.explanation: yes if DPAs are in place. no if PII is processed and a DPA is missing. not_applicable if the project does not process personal data.

statements.description: Interactive production access must require MFA.

keys.question: Is MFA required for interactive production access?
keys.explanation: yes if production SSH/console/cloud consoles require a second factor. no if password-only access is possible.
